# Kaleidoscope

> Local native memory for agents, exposed through a manager CLI and persistent stdio MCP. Release status: documentation_preview (0.1.0-rc.1); no package or production login is public.

- [Documentation](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/): product and developer overview
- [Getting started](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/getting-started/): protected RC install, profile and reversible host workflow
- [Packages](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/packages/): full SDK facades, native companions, exact macOS arm64 RC hashes and gates
- [CLI reference](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/cli/): exact local manager-candidate commands
- [MCP reference](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/mcp/): candidate-bound `search` and `remember` contract
- [Integrations](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/integrations/): Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, and generic MCP
- [Security](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/security/): package, process, and account isolation evidence
- [Privacy](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/privacy/): local/account data boundary, credential storage, and telemetry status
- [Licenses and terms](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/legal/): Apache-2.0 public software boundary, CC BY 4.0 documentation, and proprietary engine EULA
- [Privacy notice](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/legal/privacy-notice/): review draft of production privacy terms
- [Security policy](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/legal/security-policy/): review draft of disclosure, safe-harbor, and supported-version policy
- [Support policy](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/legal/support-policy/): review draft of scope, exclusions, severity, and response targets
- [Account](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/account/): login manages account/device state and does not upload local memory
- [Operations](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/operations/): backup, restore, uninstall, update, and exact vault deletion
- [Compatibility](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/compatibility/): verified local cells versus native/support holds
- [Benchmarks](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/benchmarks/): merged candidate-bound smoke, with no score or release claim
- [Release evidence](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/evidence/): exact digests, converged package proof, milestone commits, and protected gates
- [Public agent skill](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/SKILL.md): bounded retrieval and verified durable writes
- [Agent instructions](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/agent-instructions.md): safe manager-installed AGENTS, CLAUDE, and Cursor pointers
- [Machine-readable staging evidence](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/staging-evidence.json): source-free milestone and gate record
- [Cross-target checks](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/cross-target-checks.json): type-checks for non-macOS-arm64 source targets
- [Candidate CLI help](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/reference/kaleidoscope-cli.candidate.txt): exact consolidated manager help snapshot
- [Candidate MCP reference](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/reference/kaleidoscope-mcp.candidate.json): exact engine and public-contract binding plus tool fields

The `0.1.0-rc.1` package contract is verified only for macOS arm64. SDK commit 9ed39bddd7bf14e68e1c363074f6921288b9e94b puts the full public TypeScript/Python clients, installed-payload resolvers and both `kaleidoscope`/`kscope` launchers in the facade packages. Assembler commit af892d180fe01729450e03917f33ac56698e90e1 pairs them with native companions containing manager object code and the proprietary object code engine; final evidence commit 0c42ff35b789a0406aaabf6634bdb2988db36b0a freezes the result. Exact hashes: release archive 2342d12e0010e983db9cfd9c32079bddcc96e8045299c97d878f94200ef6ac8a; manifest efc41f32bea0deb4180cca85d2996c39d4793cdea78888fc6216a2dcd8ba22f8; build proof ff363dc752e19979e44b71cc2fdfe6b7f0bf136ba3c29b5cd1bc8b08aa24d053; package proof 62afa5714352615f6c2303ed6427842a70168cbfb0bb6bea0ca2753ba0d551b7; npm facade 0980c1aef2d94960e7b3384bdc932da024a9534d123d3521f05c66a1b600b4bd; npm native companion ec38717398a623fcca6043b37438ab3f6e2bcfa5790e391bb8747b63ab3f340b; Python facade 72099296676ef38b146018ae4ffac6cfb082bc8a537f178443acd351cf7bf6d7; Python native companion d265493d6ca583f2ecd9e69257c8ed604174636e1c5f3b29dc08eafe01c51d8b; SBOM 5058f2170630cb70ac14252162245f3ae94cc9d02f9b58c74d36694355094f4c; provenance 498c60561520e57834a807c2e17443b0a7eefe1c3901c67450e0506135babfb8; test-only signature envelope 9bce859379b24683cff7e6069835aa9f8d8ac4f1d07ff353f050ea1b9df60e0c. The engine source is not in any public surface. Manager SHA-256 a1eb37ab61f8f5681b654f7e25f06c3e3188720ad4cf61aaecc1ecf265e8f6c1; engine SHA-256 988192ac9677d5dd55a3642b2da493a0806bb860b5b3c0f509b37ddadee08825; public contract SHA-256 a2357ed6c00e3e143d08581590571447e31d24fd0e7d2466d28a211a0515c75e; final package evidence SHA-256 7d4b49919d9d7607542e27979b64a5f071c58418096ec2a8c74b3c211738307c; DX-09 fixture evidence SHA-256 f2d2a43bd8ee137f980c83398ec7197e26eedd2395d019926e38ea7531a2a504; historic DX-10A evidence SHA-256 cfb0c09eccc2dffeca67fb324927b602f6f1158a9d6e85682cc3112fd696b12e; historic pre-final Codex-host evidence SHA-256 74ab8ac26bbb0a3d6093c8d4db467de8d998882801a815495ada0ad0fc1ec840; local host-wiring harness commit 52ad4d243966c5a5c9f65b35909d8f029ae74afd; cross-target check evidence SHA-256 67ec1ad295ce912799c883b661e3f2f0ad6e19139a887ea190613ef4a806c55f. Final package evidence proves fresh npm/Python facade init, doctor, Codex dry-run configuration, and MCP discovery. The host harness additionally proves pinned local Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode CLI wiring and MCP discovery against a model-absent development binary. Cross-target checks pass for Linux x86_64/arm64, Windows x86_64 GNU, and macOS x64, but they are type-checks from macOS arm64 and do not prove foreign runtime, package, installer, credential-store, GUI/IDE, Cursor, or live-provider support. All packages remain private, test-signed, unpublished and outside a support claim. Hosted memory is planned, not available. Apache-2.0 and CC BY 4.0 source licensing and review-draft product terms are staged; production signing, final legal review, registry publication, and login remain separately gated.
